units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>אתה … וצוֹלֵב לזה</he> when thou raisest the one to dignity, thou must decree hanging for the other.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30">Gen. R. s. 30</cite> <he>אתמול … צוֹלֵב את צוֹלְבָיו</he> yesterday he was prepared to be hanged, and now he hangs those who had intended to hang him; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="R00489"><he>צָלוּב</he></cite>; f. <he>צְלוּבָה</he> &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:3">Yeb. XVI, 3</cite> <he>ואפי׳ ראוהו … צ׳</he> even if witnesses saw him … nailed to the stake (v. <he>צְלוּכ</he> h.) <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 7:1">Tosef. Gitt. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 5:1">V</cite>), 1; Y. ib. VII, 48ᶜ bot. <he>היה צ׳ וכ׳</he> if a man was impaled or being bled to death, and motioned (to his friends) and said, write a letter of divorce &c. Ohol. III, 5; <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 4:11">Tosef. ib. IV, 11</cite> <he>צ׳ שדמו שותת</he> one nailed to the stake whose blood runs freely.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26:1">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>לצְלוּבִים</he>, v. <cite ref="B00789"><he>בַּכִּיר</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be hanged, impaled. Esth. R. introd. (ref. to Deut. XXVIII, 66) זה שהוא יוצא להִצָּלֵב that is he who is taken out to be impaled.
units: <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:66">Ib.</cite> to I, 12 <he>אימתי … כשנ׳ המן</he> when was his wrath pacified? When Haman was hanged. Ib. to III, 1 <he>אף סופו … לִיצָּלֵב</he> this man, too, will in the end be hanged; a. fr.
